title: feat(nm2ocyt2slz): cyclic lex-largest Orient freeze t+1 vs t+2 on two-axis same-lock z-probes: reverse fails, face HOLD, composition HOLD
science: same-lock z-probes, cyclic lex-largest orientation at two cuts; face=hold at both. Composition is forced: O(q,tau) is constant for all tau>=t(q)+1 (any step e in O(q) requires e in M(q+e), which forces t(q+e)=t(q)+1), so t+2 can never differ from t+1 and composition=HOLD carries zero information.
